# Reporting a security vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub's private reporting form](https://github.com/GeneralBobi/claudian-app/security/advisories/new). Do not open a public issue containing exploitation details.

Include the affected version, expected and observed behavior, reproduction steps using fictional data, and the potential impact. Do not send your personal memory folder, recordings, credentials or live tokens. If the private form is unavailable, contact the maintainer at [boranbirtanir@hotmail.com](mailto:boranbirtanir@hotmail.com).

Security fixes are considered for the latest published preview. Older previews may need an upgrade. There is no guaranteed response deadline or paid bug-bounty program stated by this policy.

Please coordinate disclosure with the maintainer so users can receive a fix before vulnerability details are published. For current product boundaries, see [claudian.app/security](https://claudian.app/security).
